tasks.title: Announcement #36
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement by a university administration.
tasks.transcript: We apologize for the cold temperatures in campus buildings today. Overnight, a large steam pipe failed. The entire steam distribution system must be temporarily shut down to allow for repairs to the pipe. Unfortunately, this means that most buildings are currently without heat and hot water. Science Lab buildings have their own backup systems and should be unaffected. Please remember that the use of electric heaters is prohibited. These can overload buildings, electrical systems, and cause a power outage. We'll update everyone when Steam service is restored.

questions.stem: Why are most campus buildings cold?

options.A: A backup system is not working
options.B: There is no electricity on campus.
options.C: Temperatures are much colder than usual.

questions.analysis: 答案: D 题目问的是: 为什么大多数校园建筑很冷？属于细节理解题。 定位原文: “Overnight, a large steam pipe failed. The entire steam distribution system must be temporarily shut down to allow for repairs to the pipe.” 选项分析: A. “A backup system is not working.”（备用系统没有工作。）没有提到备用系统的问题，因此A选项错误。 B. “There is no electricity on campus.”（校园没有电。）原文没有提到电力问题，因此B选项错误。 C. “Temperatures are much colder than usual.”（温度比平时低很多。）没有提到天气问题，因此C选项错误。 D. “A steam pipe broke.”（蒸汽管道破裂。）这正是导致建筑物寒冷的原因，因此D选项正确。

questions.stem: Why is the use of electric heaters not allowed?

options.C: Their use of power is too expensive over time.
options.D: Heat from them can damage pipes.

questions.analysis: 答案: A 题目问的是: 为什么不允许使用电热器？属于细节理解题。 定位原文: “These can overload buildings, electrical systems, and cause a power outage.” 选项分析: A. “They can overload electrical systems.”（它们可能会使电力系统超载。）这是原文中明确指出的原因，因此A选项正确。 B. “They can affect lab experiments.”（它们可能会影响实验室实验。）没有提到这一点，因此B选项错误。 C. “Their use of power is too expensive over time.”（长期使用它们的电力过于昂贵。）原文没有提到费用问题，因此C选项错误。 D. “Heat from them can damage pipes.”（它们的热量可能会损坏管道。）原文没有提到这一点，因此D选项错误。
